goal: Generate a flowchart for the latte-making process, embedding the recipe within the steps section, emphasizing its reproducibility at home.

recipe.name: Italian latte
recipe.subtitle: Double shot espresso + thin milk foam

items: Optional: 5ml of caramel or a pinch of cinnamon powder

steps.count: Vivid magenta background steals the scene.

items.scene: Italian hand grind or electric grind to Italian fineness, tamping down grounds to fill the bowl evenly.
92℃ water, 25-30 seconds to extract about 36g of double espresso into a wide-mouth cup
Cold milk poured into the frothing pitcher, steam wand submerged below the surface to froth to 60℃
Shake the canister, draw circles to blend the milk foam, pour the concentrate into the center at a fixed point
Elevate the tank mouth and finish pulling a simplified white heart shape
Wipe the cup rim clean and place a coaster under it.

steps.step_block_style: Left has numbers, right has illustrations, with one description on the same line on the right side

final_dish.position: Close-up of the finished product on the right bottom side, with a thin glossy milk foam

style.art_style: Flat vector + large blocks of dark coffee and milky white + slight grain.
style.color_palette: Deep roast brown, ceramic white, steam gray blue

must_keep: 6-step sequence conforms to barista standard operations
Temperature and quantifiers do not contradict each other
The finished image clearly shows the contrast between coffee oils and milk foam.
avoid: Arbitrarily replace with instant coffee steps (when inconsistent with the title)
